title:
Comment of Seth Boyer in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/3/2026

documents.name: 152256.txt
documents.text:
Seth Boyer, Wasilla, AK.
I'm commenting to oppose the permitting and any subsequent construction of underwater data centers by DeepGreen Cook Inlet SPV LLC or any other firm.

While a well-studied hydro plant project for reducing Alaska's reliance on fossil fuels for a power would be welcome, generating on-site energy for a data center would bring few jobs to Alaska and cause needless environmental damage to the ecosystem, not to mention pose a quality of life reduction to human residents living anywhere near the project. Furthermore, hyperscale data centers are dead-end infrastructure with little-to-no utility after the AI bubble bursts - something that's already underway. 

This project has zero upside for Alaska and serves only to enrich the ownership class in tech and tech-related construction. I strongly oppose.
